name: ConnectSphere — Event Request Workflow

dynamicViews.description: The 14-step typical process, one interaction per step.
dynamicViews.name: Dynamic View

relationships.description: Step 1 — Draft: saves an event request with initial requirements.
Step 2 — Submission: submits the request. Mandatory fields and lead time undecided [?].
Step 3 — Assignment: assigns an Event Coordinator. Manual, no acceptance step.
Step 4 — Review: requests clarification where information is incomplete or unclear.
Step 5 — Initial approval: decides whether planning may proceed. Decision recorded either way.
Step 6 — Venue identification: searches venues by date, capacity, layout, accessibility.
Step 7 — Venue request: approves, rejects, or suggests an alternative.
Step 8 — Technical requirements: confirms and reserves what can be provided.
Step 9 — Preparation: tracks outstanding actions while staff update progress.
Step 10 — Confirmation: confirms once essential arrangements are complete.
Step 11 — Registration: registers within the permitted period, subject to capacity.
Step 12 — Changes: requests a change; the Coordinator assesses the impact.
Step 13 — Delivery: prepares the room; Technical Support prepares the equipment.
Step 14 — Completion: records attendance, notes and issues, then closes the event.
